armyRules.name: Red Tide
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Legion fights as a flood, not a line. A unit with this rule adds +1 to its Initiative on a turn it charges. A unit with this rule that neither charged nor fought in combat in its previous turn suffers -1 Cool until it does.
armyRules.condition: on a turn the unit charges

armyRules.name: Blood-Sworn Duellists
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. A Character with this rule must accept every Challenge offered to it. Each time it wins a Challenge it gains +1 Attack for the rest of the battle, to a maximum of +2.

armyRules.name: Deaf to the Guns
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. A unit with this rule ignores the Pinned and Suppressed Statuses, but its Shooting Attacks against targets more than 12" away are made at -1 Ballistic Skill.
armyRules.condition: when shooting at a target more than 12" away

wargear.name: Gore-soaked banner
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A standard stitched from the hides of the last world the company burned. On a turn the unit charges, every model in it gains +1 Attack.

wargear.name: Pit-master's goad
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A barbed prod and a bellowed name for every man in the squad. Gives the bearer's unit Goad the Pack.

wargear.name: Nail-fused torc
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A collar of bone-grey nails driven so deep the bearer no longer hears the warp. Gives the bearer Null Nail.

wargear.name: Gladiator's scar-plate
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Ceramite so battered it is more dent than plate, kept that way on purpose. Gives the bearer Pain Is Fuel.

wargear.name: Skull-tithe totem
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A pole hung with the skulls of every champion the unit has put down. Gives the unit Skull Tithe.

wargear.name: Butcher's prow
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A serrated ram bolted across the nose of a hull. Gives the vehicle Killing Prow.

wargear.name: Frenzy-cage fittings
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Hatch locks and shock-wire grips that keep the passengers quiet until the doors drop. Gives the vehicle Caged Fury.

rules.name: Hatred (Psykers)
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The Hatred (X) Special Rule, against any Model with the Psyker Trait.

rules.name: Blood Frenzy
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Berserker Charge). A unit with this rule adds +1 to its Charge rolls. On a turn it charges, it must charge the closest enemy unit it can reach.

rules.name: Witch-hunters of Nikaea
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Scorn of Nikaea). A model with this rule adds +1 to its Willpower, and passes the first Willpower Check forced on it by an enemy Psychic power each turn automatically.

rules.name: The Butcher's Chosen
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Butcher's Due). A unit with this rule gains Fear (1). If it destroys an enemy unit in combat, every friendly World Eaters unit within 12" adds +1 to its Leadership until the end of the next turn.

rules.name: Goad the Pack
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, at the start of the Charge step, the bearer's unit adds +2 to its Charge roll for one Charge. If that Charge still fails, the bearer suffers 1 Wound with no Saves allowed.

rules.name: Null Nail
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The bearer passes Willpower Checks forced by enemy Psychic powers automatically, but friendly Psychic powers cannot target the bearer.

rules.name: Pain Is Fuel
rules.text: Legacy house rule. While the bearer has lost at least one Wound it gains Feel No Pain (6+) and +1 Initiative.

rules.name: Skull Tithe
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A unit with this rule that destroyed an enemy unit in combat in its previous turn counts as having twice as many models for the purpose of holding an objective.

rules.name: Killing Prow
rules.text: Legacy house rule. On a turn this vehicle moved at least 6" and ended within 1" of an enemy Infantry unit, that unit suffers D3 Hits at Strength 6, AP 3.

rules.name: Caged Fury
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Models that disembark from this vehicle add +2 to their Charge roll that turn, but suffer -1 Cool until the end of the turn.

modifiers.text: The Nails bite deep: +1 A, -1 LD.

modifiers.condition: on a turn the unit charges

rites.name: The Berserker Charge
rites.flavor: Guns are for those who fear to close the distance.
rites.text: Guns are for those who fear to close the distance.
benefits: Rampager Squads may fill Troops slots.
Every World Eaters Infantry unit gains Fast (1) and Blood Frenzy: +1 to Charge rolls.
limitations: Units with Blood Frenzy must charge the closest enemy unit they can reach.
No Heavy Support, Tactical Support or Veteran Heavy Support Squads, no Rapier or Tarantula Batteries, and no Armour units.
At least one Rampager Squad is required.

modifiers.text: The Berserker Charge: Fast (1), Blood Frenzy.

require.note: Bring at least one Rampager Squad.

rites.name: Scorn of Nikaea
rites.flavor: The Legion was forbidden its witches. It learned to hunt everyone else's.
rites.text: The Legion was forbidden its witches. It learned to hunt everyone else's.
benefits: Every World Eaters unit gains Hatred (Psykers) and Witch-hunters of Nikaea: +1 Willpower, and the first Willpower Check forced by an enemy power each turn is passed automatically.
limitations: The army may not include any model with the Psyker Trait.

modifiers.text: Scorn of Nikaea: Hatred (Psykers), Witch-hunters of Nikaea.

rites.name: The Butcher's Due
rites.flavor: Angron's favoured walk ahead of him, and the Legion follows the blood.
rites.text: Angron's favoured walk ahead of him, and the Legion follows the blood.
benefits: Red Butchers may fill Troops slots and gain The Butcher's Chosen: Fear (1), and a unit they destroy in combat steadies every World Eaters unit nearby.
limitations: Angron, Angron Transfigured or Kharn the Bloody must be in the army.

modifiers.text: The Butcher's Due: The Butcher's Chosen, Fear (1).

require.note: Angron or Kharn must lead the army.
